description: Select a fresh-work proposal using the buyer signature. No ticket or payment is created; inspect whether the response contains a direct Work Ticket handoff or a separate protected inspection handoff. Never substitute direct checkout for protected funding. New fresh-work selections retain the exact verified message and buyer signature atomically with selection. Replays preserve the original proof. Older selections may lack the signed message; migration and replay do not reconstruct it. Public reads exclude these proofs; selections linked to direct Work Tickets can be read through the private Transaction Evidence export. Save the original message and signature locally. Selection authorizes no payment.
name: select_work_request_proposal
